extraction.title: Optimize header layout performance with flexbox mixins
extraction.head: header-layout-optimization-post

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as moving the header layout from float-based positioning to flexbox. It adds four flexbox mixins (flexbox, inline-flex, align-items, order) to mixins.scss with vendor prefixes, and updates the header, topic post, badge, and topic element styles. Confidence score of 3/5.
"Extra blank lines added between mixins create inconsistent spacing compared to the rest of the file"
Flags a missing space after the colon in the align-items declaration (align-items:$alignment;). Suggests changing it to align-items: $alignment; to match the other properties.
Flags a missing space in the Flexbox section comment. Suggests changing it to "// Flexbox" to match the comment style used elsewhere in the file.
